purpose: Blocking integrity and fidelity gate for deliverables that consume Brand Packs and client-owned rules.

checks.check: the resolved folder named brand exists, contains at least one valid pack, and the intended slug is selected unambiguously
status and validate completed without errors
source, tokens, guidelines, manifest, and optional client rules were read
pack surface rules and applicable active client rules were loaded through context
only declared assets were used, except authorized output-local icon extensions that satisfy the guardrail
when the pack declares iconography and the surface contains actions, capabilities, states, or editorial blocks, the inventory was read and official assets were mapped before creating markers
every non-canonical icon had explicit authorization, follows the declared family construction, lives only in the output, and does not alter the Brand Pack
semantic roles were preferred and no token was invented
copy follows tone, anchor words, forbidden words, pack rules, and applicable client rules
deliverable-only feedback was not persisted and every lasting rule was written only to brand.rules.json through learn
technical project checks and surface review were completed
editorial guidelines were loaded for a document or presentation
complete content and global order were preserved unless the user requested an editorial change
desktop, mobile, and applicable export renders were inspected without overflow or clipping
headings, introductions, lists, and components remain legibly grouped across pages
cards, dividers, and callouts have a semantic function, and no emphasis defaults to a rounded surface with a colored left rule
continuous flow or page canvas was chosen intentionally for an HTML document based on reading and export needs
when HTML is paginated, geometry derives from the final format, screen and @page stay aligned, preview chrome does not reach print, and mobile remains fluid unless requested otherwise
